description: Integration module to wire mcp_traffic_fingerprints.py (already built 2026-04-22) into mcp_scanner. The fingerprints library exports detect_mcp_methods(), is_mcp_traffic(), extract_session_indicators(). Wire mcp_scanner to call is_mcp_traffic() against candidate server responses for MCP protocol confirmation. MUST use write_service for any state writes (table=mcp_signal_scores with signal_type, confidence, evidence_blob). No direct DB access. No HTTP between peer daemons. This is integration only, not a rebuild of either file.
